section_summary.extract_value: This section summarizes findings regarding practice variability, self-efficacy, and transfer. It reports that practice variability did not relate to mean training performance but influenced training performance variability and transfer, with low variability leading to higher near transfer and high variability to higher far transfer. It also found that higher practice variability led to higher self-efficacy generality, which in turn served as an intervening variable between practice variability and far transfer.
